quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (annual report): in 2025 the Langfang, Pinghu, Foshan and Huizhou parks delivered 220MW of computing centers, including what the company calls the industry's first single 100MW ultra-large intelligent computing center; annual delivery exceeded 40% of the previous sixteen years' cumulative total. Cumulative delivery reached 750MW, and mature computing centers have a racking rate above 90%. Energy-consumption quota reserves at end-2025 were about 30% higher than a year earlier. It is accelerating construction of what it calls the industry's first single 200MW intelligent computing center, able to host clusters of more than 10 ten-thousand cards, and a 200MW ultra-large liquid-cooled intelligent computing cluster. Power: three new 110kV substations at Langfang Zone B (one built, two about to start), a second 110kV substation in operation in the Yangtze River Delta park with a new 220kV substation in preliminary design, Foshan's 110kV substation in operation, Huizhou's and Chongqing's about to start. It won the Foshan phase II land in February 2026 and the Hong Kong Sha Ling data park industrial land in March 2026 (planned intelligent computing floor area 25 ten-thousand square meters).
quarterly_data.figure: 220MW delivered in 2025; 750MW cumulative; racking rate above 90%

quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): the company will ensure delivery and racking of Langfang Zone B, Pinghu Zone D, Foshan phase I and Huizhou phase I, focus on building and delivering the single 200MW new-generation intelligent computing center, and speed up construction of its 7 domestic and 2 overseas ultra-large campus-level AI infrastructure clusters; it expects revenue to be released steadily as new computing centers are delivered and racked. It plans to export O&M services to the computing centers in its REIT platform and build an overseas O&M team of more than 300 people (it has a self-operated O&M team of more than 1,600 people), and to pursue acquisitions with synergies.
quarterly_data.figure: Single 200MW new-generation intelligent computing center to be built and delivered
